scenes.title: Power Platform ALM: govern one release path
scenes.body: Bottom line: use one ALM path; ship a managed artifact, set target config, move data apart, and do DLP, test, license and approval checks before final go-live.
scenes.narration: Bottom line: use one ALM path; ship a managed artifact, set target config, move data apart, and do DLP, test, license and approval checks before final go-live.
claims: Power Platform ALM spans apps, automation, sites, agents and Dataverse; executives should manage it as one governed delivery path.
Use source control as truth, build changes in unmanaged solutions, and export managed solutions as downstream build artifacts.
Promote the same artifact through ordered stages; configure each target, and move Dataverse table records separately.
Automate delivery with pipelines and CI/CD; Microsoft documentation points to Azure DevOps or GitHub for some scenarios.
Before production, check DLP connector controls, tests, analytics, approvals and managed-environment licensing.
